entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The pulse monitor is absolute garbage. It's completely inaccurate.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with that feature. Sometimes a quick reset can clear that up. Would you be open to trying a few troubleshooting steps with me?
No. I don't have time for all that. I just want my money back. This thing doesn't work and I want a refund.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order details to check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 17 days ago, on December 15th.
Alright, I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Whatever. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Once we receive the item back, the refund will be credited to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a nice day.
